Bill.BriefDescription: Removing limit on ethics board penalties and costs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ethics board penalties and costs; and amendingRCW 42.52.500.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.52.500 and 1994 c 154 s 220 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If an ethics board finds that there is reasonable cause to believethat a violation has occurred, the board shall consider the possibilityof the alleged violator having to pay a total amount of penalty andcosts of more than five hundred dollars. Based on such consideration,the board may give the person who is the subject of the complaint theoption to have an administrative law judge conduct the hearing and ruleon procedural and evidentiary matters. The board may also, on its owninitiative, provide for retaining an administrative law judge. ((Anethics board may not require total payment of more than five hundreddollars in penalty and costs in any case where an administrative lawjudge is not used and the board did not give such option to the personwho is the subject of the complaint.))
